chapter_note: The chapter is overwhelmingly a systematic cosmological teaching on the three-zone construction of the universe (Darkness powers → sons of the Man → sons of the Living Spirit), with only a brief hagiographic/dialogue-style incipit. No NT citations or pastoral/application pivots appear; the mappings remain cosmos→cosmos throughout. The final paragraph is fragmentary (lacunae) but still within the same structural exposition (King of Honour in the firmaments/universe).

paragraphs.temporal_note: Formulaic opening attribution (“Once again the enlightener speaks…”) is a classic Kephalaia hagiographic frame marker.

paragraphs.core_text: When he built and constructed the worlds, he suspended the zones on their zones, and within another zone also. The first zone is the five powers of Darkness, males and females.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Impersonal cosmological mechanics (“built…constructed…suspended”) and a numbered structural identification of zones; no institutional or exhortative application.

paragraphs.core_text: This is why he hung one zone on a zone! He hung the five powers of Darkness on the five shining men, the sons of the Man; because all the enmity is entwined and bound in them.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Continues the internal cosmic architecture via a direct mapping (Darkness powers → shining men/sons of the Man) with functional rationale; stays within the system.

paragraphs.core_text: Also, within the zone are the five sons of the [Living] Spirit; because the entire edifice is suspended from them, it being [ ... ... he]ard (?) him too, the oth[ers ... ... ] after them.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Systematic five-fold cosmological structuring (sons of the Living Spirit) and architectural dependence (“edifice…suspended”)—a substrate-style ‘how it works’ description; lacunae reflect manuscript damage, not layering.

paragraphs.core_text: And this is the one who came to [ ... ... the fi]rmaments above [ ... ] which is in one zone, is the great [King of Honour] who e[xists ... ] within the [ ... ... ] of the universe.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Despite heavy lacunae, it names a key cosmic being (King of Honour) and locates him in the firmaments/universe—still cosmological exposition without frame/pastoral/NT overlay.
